I would like to take 5 min to discuss Rest-SSZ, in particular the missing non-engine methods that are exposed on the engine port. Those are:
```
# Still used (according to LH)
- eth_syncing
- eth_getBlockByNumber
- eth_getBlockByHash
- eth_chainId
# used in eth1 deposit path
- eth_blockNumber
- eth_call
- eth_getLogs
# unused
- eth_getCode
- eth_sendRawTransaction
```

I would be curious if 
- Other clients need the same 4 methods?
- Are there additional methods needed/useful?
- Can we retire the eth1 deposit path?
